meta.title: Vendor PO Acknowledgment: refused for a user without the Vendor role
gaps: Open Vendor PO Acknowledgment for a purchase order with a committed delivery date and accept or flag it as a user without the Vendor role.
Repeat the acknowledgment action as a Vendor and compare whether the action is available.
Verify the tenant's RBAC configuration when access is granted to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open Vendor PO Acknowledgment for a purchase order with a committed delivery date and accept or flag it as a user without the Vendor role.; Repeat the acknowledgment action as a Vendor and compare whether the action is available.; Verify the tenant's RBAC configuration when access is granted to additional roles.

args.need: sign in as the non-Vendor user and as a Vendor on the same tenant, open Vendor PO Acknowledgment for a purchase order with a committed delivery date, attempt to accept or flag it in both roles, and report whether the action is refused or absent for the non-Vendor user and available to the Vendor

steps.note: The catalog cannot reach or assert the Vendor PO Acknowledgment portal flow or switch between these arbitrary user roles.
Assert that the session remains free of application errors after the tester's comparison.
